summary: In this session from Zadul-Ma'ad (Provisions for the Hereafter), Sheikh Ali Mashhour continues discussing the miracles of Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him), emphasizing that the Quran is the greatest of all miracles. Beyond the extraordinary miracles like the splitting of the moon, the speaker highlights more subtle but equally compelling miracles: the Prophet's consistent message throughout his 23 years of prophethood, his unwavering humility despite increasing power, his remarkable generosity, and his audacious prophecies made during times of hardship—such as declaring that Islam would reach wherever day and night reach while his companions were starving. The speaker contrasts the Prophet's steady consistency with false prophets and cult leaders throughout history, who become increasingly arrogant and delusional over time.
suggested_title: The Subtle Miracles of Prophet Muhammad: Consistency, Character, and Prophetic Vision
catchy_title: Why False Prophets Always Reveal Themselves
